A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete 39-page documents, including Appendices A–U. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content apart from the page 1 arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original LoRA experiments on PhoneBook, CounterFact, PaperQA, NarrativeQA, and QuALITY, including benchmark results, ablations, and latency measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, including Table 2's benchmark comparisons and Appendix E's ablations and adapter-variant experiments.

M1.justification: The investigated LoRA training, synthetic-supervision, routing, merging, and hybrid-memory procedures are identical in both versions.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same PhoneBook, CounterFact, PaperQA, NarrativeQA, and QuALITY coverage, including the same memory, routing, and long-document scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within every matched experiment, including Table 2's baselines, Figure 20's merging methods, and Table 4's DoRA/PiSSA comparisons.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, data selections, model configurations, training budgets, chunking, and testing procedures match throughout, including Appendix D's master configuration and Appendix Q's benchmark settings.

E4.justification: The layer/module ablations, adapter-variant tests, capacity and supervision analyses, routing/merging analyses, and latency case study are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. No seed or run-count information, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests are added, removed, or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results, and reported findings match. For example, Table 2 retains Llama-3.1-8B single-LoRA scores of 27.05 on NarrativeQA and 42.42 on QuALITY.

T1.justification: Equation 1's parameter-efficiency definition and Appendix O's merging formulas are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about LoRA's capacity, supervision, modular composition, and complementarity with RAG and ICL.

C2.justification: Interpretations of saturation, routing errors, merging interference, and hybrid-memory benefits are unchanged, as are the continual-update and deployment limitations in Section 8.

D1.justification: Dataset construction, prompts, hyperparameters, hardware, software, and timing instructions are identical, including Appendices B–D, I, and U. Code/data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, and the reference list are identical; neither cited-work membership nor research positioning changes.

P1.justification: Only the page 1 arXiv stamp changes from 'v1 ... 1 Mar 2026' to 'v2 ... 6 May 2026'. The paper's prose, terminology, headings, and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–22, Tables 1–5, captions, and placement are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–39 match pixel-for-pixel; page 1 differs only in the marginal version/date text, without changing the layout.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves all scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility details, and displays from v1, including the appendices. Updating only the arXiv version/date stamp leaves the paper's overall quality unchanged.
